intent: Teach shore viewpoint, comparative beach-cleanliness instructions, calm-enough sea conditions, possible long-distance plastic drift, entire-lake path coverage, dusk pond gathering, stepping-stone crossings and hearing-before-seeing order.
picturePurpose: Four reversible viewpoint/condition/extent/crossing diagrams, three exact evidence selections and one sensory-order task; original source facts stay separate from measurements and completion claims.

transfer.stem: 先后、时间和环湖范围都改了，哪组英文保留三条新信息？
transfer.passage:
三条新信息
我们先看到瀑布，后听到声音。青蛙在黎明时聚在池塘边。一条小路只绕湖的一部分。
词语提示：dawn 黎明；only part of 只有……的一部分。

options.text: We heard the waterfall before we saw it. Frogs gather beside the pond at dawn. A path goes around only part of the lake.
We saw the waterfall before we heard it. Frogs gather beside the pond at dusk. A path goes around only part of the lake.

answer.display: We saw the waterfall before we heard it. Frogs gather beside the pond at dawn. A path goes around only part of the lake.

explanation.strategy: 逐项核对新的感官先后、聚集时间与路径范围。

steps.text: 先看到后听到：saw the waterfall before we heard it。
steps.reason: 本题把看到放在前，不是旧句先听到。

只绕湖的一部分：goes around only part of the lake。
steps.reason: only part of限定一部分，不是entire整个。

distractors.reason: heard before saw把先看到改回先听到。
entire把只有一部分改成整座湖。
